The only substantive public record located is the Indian Kanoon case corpus (77 hits for the name), which shows a long-running pattern of customs disputes: import undervaluation of fresh apples (CESTAT 2019, with a director-level admission that actual consignment value was not declared), customs valuation/classification appeals at Nhava Sheva and Cochin, a 2017 Madras High Court writ against the Assistant Commissioner of Customs, and a fresh CESTAT appeal filed 10.09.2026 against a 17.03.2026 Order-in-Original of the Principal Commissioner of Customs (NS-I). Income-tax appeals before ITAT Mumbai (Central Circle-1(3)) for A.Y. 2015-16 indicate a central-circle/search-related assessment history. Per project rules these are noted neutrally as 'есть сложности' and are not rejection grounds. No credit rating found in public sources (null).
